finding: The proposed route still required Ahmed to open repository files and paste full commissions into destination chats even though Claude has GitHub and browser access.
operating_rule: Use reference-based dispatch when the receiver can dereference; otherwise the constituted relay fetches and transmits exact content. Ahmed performs only the smallest platform-owner act.
proof_or_recheck: Claude must create a GitHub receipt with exact destination locators, message IDs and read-back standing.

finding: Asking SW to describe its method can produce incomplete or polished self-report without exposing actual decomposition, tool use, state, recovery and coordination.
operating_rule: Use real bounded non-secret work; capture platform-visible traces, artefacts, failures and receipts; compare self-description with operation.
proof_or_recheck: SW programme must exercise prior-state recovery, reference dispatch, correction propagation, failure recovery and founder-burden tests.

finding: The phrase 'full thinking' risks promoting a commercial thesis into an unsupported claim of access to hidden chain of thought.
operating_rule: Describe and monetise only platform-visible operational intelligence; label displayed rationale and inferred method accurately.
proof_or_recheck: Live observation record separates OBSERVED traces from INFERRED internal method.

finding: ChatGPT coordination defects prompted consideration of moving the whole operation into Cursor before continuity, repository dependency and control-plane requirements were established.
operating_rule: Correct the coordination defect with durable state and reference relay; evaluate Cursor as an execution surface on isolated fixtures before selecting it as a control plane.
proof_or_recheck: Cursor entry requires repository classification, export/rebuild and rollback evidence.

finding: Historical channel-control rules risked making a broad founder-question programme a prerequisite even after current direction was sufficient to start bounded internal research.
operating_rule: Run founder elicitation adaptively against exact decision dependencies; do not re-ask settled direction or block delegated technical research.
proof_or_recheck: Current launch has no founder-only blocker; later questions must name the decision they change.

finding: A fresh Claude account may reduce context contamination but does not automatically provide independent evidence or a better operator.
operating_rule: Use a fresh account only when a cold-start or independent-acceptance design specifies distinct evidence, context, method and acceptance ownership.
proof_or_recheck: Strategic Control decides after the first SW checkpoint whether the fresh-account lane changes a material decision.

finding: An authority-sequencing rule was overgeneralised into a blanket prohibition on specifying method to a tool.
operating_rule: Before method evidence, state goal, evidence and boundaries and let the native surface choose. After bounded research and acceptance, encode the proven method for repeatability and evaluation.
proof_or_recheck: SW return separates discovery method from accepted reusable operating procedure.
